    m_e = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["electron_mass_GeV"]
    m_mu = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["muon_mass_GeV"]
    m_tau = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["tau_mass_GeV"]
    m_H  = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["higgs_mass_GeV"]
    lam  = sat.CONSTS["defaults"]["lambda"]

    ts = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    sha = sha256_of(SAT_FULL)

    t = sat.run_tests()
    is_green = sat.tests_green(t)

    additions.append(f"\n## {args.section}\n")
    additions.append("**Run parameters**")
    param_rows = [
        ["m*", f"{m_star:.3e} GeV"],
        ["λ", f"{lam}"],
        ["m_e", f"{m_e} GeV"],
        ["m_μ", f"{m_mu} GeV"],
        ["m_τ", f"{m_tau} GeV"],
        ["m_H", f"{m_H} GeV"],
        ["LEAN_MODE.md", "present"]
    ]
    additions.append(format_table(param_rows, ["Parameter","Value"]))

    additions.append("\n**Test Summary**")
    rows = [[k, "PASS" if v.get("pass") else "FAIL"] for k,v in t.items()]
    additions.append(format_table(rows, ["Test", "Result"]))
    additions.append(f"\nOverall: **{'GREEN' if is_green else 'RED'}**")

    if is_green:
        additions.append("\n**Parameter Sweep (λ, ΔK, m_{ℓ4}) → [y_{μ4}, Δa_μ]**")
        lambdas = [0.095, 0.100, 0.105, 0.110]
        dKs = [35, 37, 39, 41]
        mL4s = [90.0, 105.0, 140.0]
        sweep_rows = []
        for L in lambdas:
            for dK in dKs:
                y = sat.overlap(dK, L)
                for mL in mL4s:
                    est = sat.gminus2_mu_estimate(L, dK, m_mu, mL, m_H).value
                    sweep_rows.append([f"{L:.3f}", str(dK), f"{mL:g}", f"{y:.4f}", f"{est:.2e}"])
        additions.append(format_table(sweep_rows, ["λ","ΔK","m_{ℓ4} (GeV)","y_{μ4}","Δa_μ"]))    

    additions.append("\n**Predictions**")
    db_mid = sat.delta_beta_deg(1e-3, delta_theta4)
    additions.append(format_table([["Δβ at g_{θγ}=1e−3, Δθ₄=2π/3", f"{db_mid:.4f}°"]], ["Quantity","Value"]))

    additions.append("\n**Kill-Criteria Evaluation**")
    g2_ok = t.get("gminus2_window",{}).get("pass", False)
    if not g2_ok and is_green:
        lambdas = [0.095, 0.100, 0.105, 0.110]
        dKs = [35, 37, 39, 41]
        mL4s = [90.0, 105.0, 140.0]
        for L in lambdas:
            for dK in dKs:
                for mL in mL4s:
                    est = sat.gminus2_mu_estimate(L, dK, m_mu, mL, m_H).value
                    if 1.6e-9 <= est <= 3.4e-9:
                        g2_ok = True
                        break
                if g2_ok: break
            if g2_ok: break
    bire_ok = (0.03 <= db_mid <= 0.09)
    kc_rows = [["g-2 viability", "PASS" if g2_ok else "FAIL"],
               ["Birefringence visibility", "PASS" if bire_ok else "FAIL"]]
    additions.append(format_table(kc_rows, ["Criterion","Result"]))

    if not is_green:
        additions.append("\n**Failure Appendix**")
        for k,v in t.items():
            if not v.get("pass"):
                additions.append(f"- {k}: {json.dumps(v)}")

    out_text = base.rstrip() + "\n\n" + "\n".join(additions) + "\n"
    out.write_text(out_text)
    print(f"Wrote: {out}")
